engine: Kokoro-82M (open model, Apache-2.0 licence, run locally)
previous_choice: ElevenLabs 'Simone' (not used: the free plan is not licensed for commercial use)
how_it_works: Every sentence Pip can say is split by src/speech.js into whole-sentence, phrase and number clips. narration/audio holds the recorded clips as audio sprites plus map.json; build.js copies them into dist/audio and embeds the map. Sentences without clips fall back to the device voice.
disclosure: Pip tells children his voice is made by a computer; the privacy notice says the voice is AI-generated audio included in the app.
